about: Rivals the tower skips because their site is gone, parked or moved to another domain, or is a non-site (a tracker, sync, CDN or connectivity endpoint with nothing on its home page to use), each with the evidence of a real fetch (tools/tower-alive.mjs). Re-checked on every run.
